request.description: A seamless tileable wall texture, a flat repeating architectural surface filling the entire image edge to edge with no border and no background. Rough grey quarried stone laid in courses, with heavy orc-made timber pinned across it — squared beams lashed with rope, driven iron pins, a hide strap, a salvaged plank laid over an older repair. Over-built and structural: every band, strap and pin is holding something and nothing is there to be looked at. Stone and timber both rubbed smooth where shoulders and hands pass. Nothing is broken and nothing has collapsed; it is used up, not ruined. The pattern continues past all four edges of the frame.
